==Description==
'''Ghost''' is an enemy type that mostly prevents enemies with it from colliding with units.

==Mechanics==
'''Ghost''' prevents the enemy from being dealt damage through collision. This is mostly damage dealt by units when they collide with another enemy, though if a tower deals collision damage, '''Ghost''' enemies will be immune to it. Such tower is the [[Trapper]], as its spike and bear traps deal collision damage. The [[Barricade]] consumable also cannot damage them. This does not make it immune to any other source of damage from units, such as their guns, as long as these units can detect them. '''Ghost''' is also most often paired with the [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy type, though this is not always the case.
